title: canthium ramosii
intro: Canthium ramosii, commonly known as the "Kadu" plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
